d: An anthropomorphic red panda with a heavy, muscular build and a jovial expression, appearing as a mature adult. The creature has reddish-brown fur with cream-colored accents around the eyes and muzzle, a thick cream-colored mane, and a broad, smiling face with narrow, orange-brown eyes. It wears a dark brown wide-brimmed hat adorned with a white feather, a red and gold open robe, and dark brown trousers with red accents. Visible accessories include a large gold and red ornate staff and a brown leather backpack. BODY COLOR: Reddish-brown and cream LEGS: Plantigrade with large, padded paws and visible claws.
